draft.subject: Thanks for the onboarding note, Felix
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thank you for the kind words about the onboarding flow — that's great to hear, and I've kept your note open on our side so it reaches the right people.

Whenever you're ready for the next step: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the easiest place to begin. If it's helpful, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week — just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
